_status: Final for this POC. All 12 categories kept and justified in part1/README.md (Guiso / Culture 500 + ESG-era codes for Part 2/3).
_anchors: Guiso, Sapienza & Zingales (2015), 'The value of corporate culture', JFE: coded values advertised on S&P 500 websites (e.g. integrity, teamwork, innovation, respect, quality).

Sull, Turconi & Sull (MIT Sloan Management Review, Culture 500): nine most-cited corporate values -- agility, collaboration, customer, diversity, execution, innovation, integrity, performance, respect.
Added ESG-era categories (environment, community, safety, shareholder) because Part 2 compares stated values against ESG/proxy disclosures; these let Parts 1 and 2 share a vocabulary.

categories.integrity: Ethics, honesty, trust, transparency, compliance, doing the right thing.
categories.customer: Customer focus, serving clients/patients, customer obsession, satisfaction.
categories.innovation: Innovation, technology leadership, creativity, R&D, pioneering, invention.
categories.collaboration: Teamwork, partnership, working together, one-team language.
categories.respect_people: Respect, dignity, caring for employees, wellbeing, development, talent.
categories.performance_execution: Excellence, results, accountability, quality, operational execution, agility.
categories.environment_sustainability: Climate, emissions, sustainability, environmental stewardship, energy transition.
categories.community_social_impact: Community investment, philanthropy, social responsibility, societal purpose.
categories.safety: Workplace/product/patient safety, health and safety culture.
categories.shareholder_value: Shareholder returns, long-term value creation for owners, financial discipline.
categories.purpose_mission: Explicit purpose/mission statements that frame why the company exists beyond profit.
